class.name: NetwInterestRelay
class.brief_description: What the server has not yet told each peer about what it can see, in the order it happened.
class.description: Order per peer is the contract. An enter and the exit that follows it are the same route twice, so a queue that reordered them would hand a peer a live route it was just told to forget. Across peers there is no order to keep, since no peer can observe another's. [codeblock] append(peer, edge) queue one edge for one peer targets() the peers owed anything wire_for(peer) that peer's edges as wire rows, oldest first forget(peer) a peer that left owes nothing and is owed nothing clear() the session ended [/codeblock]

method.name: append
method.description: Queues [param edge] for [param peer_id]. A null [param edge] is dropped, so a caller may hand this the answer of [method NetwInterestAwareness.layer_edge] without checking it first.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets every peer and everything owed to them.

method.name: forget
method.description: Drops [param peer_id] and its backlog. A peer that left cannot be told anything, and re-queuing for it later starts a new backlog at the end.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Whether any peer is owed anything.

method.name: targets
method.description: The peers owed anything, in the order each was first owed something.

method.name: wire_for
method.description: [param peer_id]'s pending edges as [method NetwInterestAwareness.to_array] rows, oldest first. A peer owed nothing answers an empty [Array].
